context: This criteria evaluates how well the engineer uses eslint-plugin-react-compiler's advanced features to build a configuration module. The assessment focuses on proper usage of the plugin's error severity configuration, custom logger integration, and metrics tracking capabilities.

checklist.name: Error Severity Configuration
checklist.description: Uses ErrorSeverity enum to create a Set for the reportableLevels option. Should import ErrorSeverity from 'babel-plugin-react-compiler/src' and convert the severity level string array to a Set of ErrorSeverity values (e.g., ErrorSeverity.InvalidReact, ErrorSeverity.InvalidJS).

checklist.name: Logger Interface Implementation
checklist.description: Implements a custom logger object with a logEvent method that conforms to the Logger interface. The logger should handle different event kinds including 'CompileSuccess' and 'CompileError' appropriately.

checklist.name: Metrics Extraction
checklist.description: Correctly extracts compilation metrics from CompileSuccess events. Should access event.memoValues for memoized value count and event.fnName for the function/component name when event.kind === 'CompileSuccess'.

checklist.name: Rule Configuration Format
checklist.description: Returns a properly formatted ESLint rule configuration array with ['error', options] where options contains the reportableLevels Set and logger object. The configuration should be compatible with the react-compiler/react-compiler rule.
